people.name: Antioch
people.line: A major city where the gospel spread to Gentiles.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
translations.bsb: When Cephas came to Antioch, however, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
translations.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
